name: Servant leadership

phase_0.boundary_condition: The covenant of mutual accountability between leader and collective

VINIT.justification: The unorganized state of a group before a common purpose or leadership structure emerges

TANCH.justification: The terminal state where the needs of the whole are met through the service of the leader

AFWD.justification: The directed transformation of authority into the growth of subordinates

AREV.justification: The descent of the leader from a position of status to a position of service

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of trust and responsibility from leader to team

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-recognition of the leader as a member of the community they serve

FSPLIT.justification: The division of centralized authority into individual autonomy and collective responsibility

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of distributed autonomy into a single coherent organizational direction

EVALT.justification: The affirmative state where the team gains capability and independence

EVALF.justification: The negative state where authority is used for self-interest rather than service

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous holding of the highest rank and the lowest functional role

IFIX.justification: The permanent cultural record of the leader's impact on the organization

phase_3.void_description: Anarchy or lack of shared direction
phase_3.true_description: Sustainable organizational health and member development
phase_3.false_description: Tyranny or organizational collapse through neglect
phase_3.both_description: The tension of leading while following

steps.domain_action: The emergence of a group with unmet needs and latent capacity
The leader identifies their own values with the needs of the group
The leader descends from personal ambition to the role of servant
The leader divides their authority to empower the collective
The team exercises autonomy and achieves measurable growth
The leader directs this growth toward the common goal
The diverse efforts of the team converge into a unified outcome
The success of the mission reinforces the bond of trust
The leader maintains the paradox of being both authority and servant
The transformation of the group culture is recorded in institutional memory
The system reaches a state of self-sustaining collective flourishing

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The ethical framework or code of conduct
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Active listening and transparent feedback loops
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The shared history and cultural norms of the group
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The prioritization of needs based on urgency and impact
phase_5.alfs_store: The foundational mission statement or charter

phase_6.cycle_cost: Emotional labor and personal ego sacrifice
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The energy lost in leader descent is recovered in collective gain
